articles.title: Liverpool Barcola Talks, Man Utd Baleba Deal & Man City’s Enzo Plan
articles.description: Liverpool are pushing to strengthen their attack before the transfer deadline, with Bradley Barcola talks ongoing and several alternatives under consideration. Manchester United also remain confident of signing Carlos Baleba after continuing negotiations with Brighton.Elsewhere, Manchester City are weighing up major midfield moves, including Enzo Fernandez, while Tottenham continue talks over further additions. Aston Villa are also set for a busy end to the window, with Nicolas Jackson a target and Al-Hilal pushing to sign Ollie Watkins.
